name: Delayed Function
description: This algorithm generates a variety of one-shot functions after a delay, when triggered. The logic of each channel is as follows: When triggered, it immediately jumps to its idle voltage, if not already there. It stays at that voltage for the duration set by the Delay parameter. It then executes the function, for the duration set by the Time parameter, if relevant (for example, the Step function has no duration). Depending on the function, it then remains at the active or idle voltage until triggered again.
use_cases: Generating one-shot functions after a delay
Trigger-based pulse, step, ramp, and sawtooth generation
gui_description: The display shows, for each channel, from top to bottom: The remaining time of the delay, once triggered. The remaining time of the function. The output function as a bar graph.

specifications.name: Channels
specifications.description: The number of functions to generate.

parameters.name: Detection
parameters.description: Sets the method of trigger detection, either 'Efficient' or 'Accurate'.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Chooses the function from the table above.

parameters.name: Delay multiplier
parameters.description: Sets a multiplier for the delay time, one of x1, x2, x5, x10, x20, x50, or x100.

parameters.name: Time multiplier
parameters.description: Sets a multiplier for the function duration, one of x1, x2, x5, x10, x20, x50, or x100.

parameters.name: Output mode
parameters.description: The standard Add/Replace mode selector as described above.

parameters.name: MIDI channel
parameters.description: The MIDI channel on which notes can trigger the function generator.

parameters.name: I2C channel
parameters.description: The I2C channel on which notes can trigger the function generator.

parameters.name: Note number
parameters.description: The MIDI or I2C note number that will trigger the function generator, or '-1' for 'Any'.

input_ports.name: Trigger input
input_ports.description: The bus to use for the trigger input.

output_ports.name: Output
output_ports.description: The bus to use for the channel output.
